review_text: The coffee itself is decent, and the place has a nice ambiance, but the food is unfortunately overpriced for what you get. Portions are noticeably small considering the high prices, which makes it hard to feel satisfied after a meal. The quality of the food is somehow just acceptable and it doesn’t justify the cost, especially if you’re expecting value for money. This spot might work for a quick coffee, but I wouldn’t recommend it if you're looking for quality food. Definitely not going back.

We’ve been here before, but it was quite busy at the time, so we weren’t really able to enjoy the place. This time, we dropped by around 8 AM when there were only a few customers, and it made a huge difference, we got to truly appreciate the ambiance, the spacious layout, and the beautiful interiors. I also discovered a new favorite: their Vietnamese Latte — highly recommended! Along with our drinks, we ordered the Bacon 4 Cheese Sandwich, which turned out to be very generous in portion size and definitely too much for two people. We could barely finish both slices. Lol. Regarding the pricing, some say it's more expensive than Starbucks, but based on our order, we definitely got our money’s worth, and then some. The barista was very patient and accommodating. It took us a while to decide, but she remained polite, offered great recommendations, and clearly explained what each blend included. We ended up going with her suggestions and they did not disappoint. Pro tip: The best time to visit is in the morning, when it’s still quiet and relaxed. The worst time is late afternoon, as the place tends to get really crowded by then.
Staff are nice and welcoming! Probably the prettiest cafe i’ve been to here in davao

I don’t know about y’all but this place is great. Food may seem expensive but when you get a taste of it, you can say it’s worth every peso you spent on it. It’s easy to find since it is located just right next to the entrance of the Vista Mall so parking area will not be an issue. The place is a perfect example of what people nowadays call “aesthetic” and their coffee taste so good with a certain bitterness that most coffee lovers what to find in their coffee. If I’m a person who live nearby, I’d probably be here like 2-3 days a week.

Up and running at 7 a.m., this place is accessed from the front of Vista Mall building. Interior design and space is admirable. The menu boasts of choices from all-day breakfast meals to salads, pastas to sandwiches, even pizzas and of course coffee and non-coffee beverages. Seating is also good for groups and solo dining. The Creamy Pesto and Mushroom pasta, Green Apple Cucumber Slush, Mushroom and Chicken Fillet, strong and hot Americano all pricey yet tasty and generous in size. Banana Muffin and Choco Chip Brownies, sadly way too sweet. With its corners and turns, and security guard constantly on his phone, hiding at the side, BE MINDFUL of your belongings.

Coffee Project Mintal is a nice stop in the Mintal area if you want a café with a more polished and comfortable setting. The place feels more designed than a simple coffee stop, so it works well for people who want to sit down, relax a bit, or meet someone in a quieter indoor space. It is a good option for coffee, light food, or a short break while spending time around this part of Davao. The overall atmosphere seems better suited for a slow visit rather than a quick grab-and-go stop.

I wouldn’t say that this place is the best, but it’s also not the worst. While the place and the aesthetics are something you could post on instagram, the food and coffee however falls short of that vibe. My iced americano taste burnt and my carbonara was mid. Overall, my experience with coffee project is not bad, nor it was memorable to the point that it will be my new caffeine spot.

Coffee Project is a newly opened Cafe at Vista Mall in Mintal, Davao City. The ambiance is cosy, walls with artistic murals that add warmth and playfulness. It's a self service Cafe. Once you ordered and paid at the counter, a buzzer will be handed to you. You take it to your table and wait until it vibrates and flashes. This means your food is ready for pick up at the hand off counter. Coffee Project offers different kind of pasta, sandwiches, pizzas and the typical Filipino food which is fried chicken with rice. I ordered their Clubhouse Sandwich was humongous. My husband has chosen the Continental Breakfast with huge sausage (which was surprisingly delicious), bacon, fried egg, toasted bread with butter and marmalade, waffles with maple syrup. My verdict: Cosy place, reasonable price and delicious food. Highly recommended!

As a coffee enthusiast, I was thrilled to discover Coffee Project, located in Vistamall, Davao City. The ambiance of the coffee shop is simply stunning, with its spacious and well-designed interior that feels like a lush garden. The abundance of natural light and greenery creates a peaceful and calming environment that's perfect for enjoying a cup of coffee or working on your laptop. The coffee at Coffee Project is nothing short of exceptional. The beans are expertly roasted, resulting in a perfectly balanced brew with no unpleasant acidity. You can tell that the baristas take great care in crafting each cup of coffee, ensuring that every customer is satisfied with their drink. But Coffee Project is more than just a coffee shop; it's an experience. Whether you're meeting friends, working remotely, or simply taking a break, the atmosphere of the shop elevates your coffee-drinking experience to new heights. For coffee lovers who appreciate excellent coffee and a beautiful, calming environment, Coffee Project in Vistamall, Davao City, is a must-visit. So, come and indulge in a cup of coffee that will leave you craving for more.

Coffee Project Mintal has become one of my go-to spots whenever I want to work, chill, or just enjoy a good cup of coffee. The place is beautifully designed — cozy, Instagram-worthy, and has that relaxing vibe that makes you want to stay longer. The coffee’s solid, and their food options are great too. I’ve tried a few of their pasta and pastries — everything was well-prepared and satisfying. It’s a bit on the pricier side compared to smaller cafés, but the ambiance and quality make up for it. What I like most is that it’s quiet enough for focus but not boring. It’s the perfect balance if you want to get things done or catch up with someone without all the noise. Definitely worth checking out if you’re in Mintal.
